title: 第6章 伏杀第7章 祸不单行第8章 蛟龙
content_zh:
“殿下，前面就是灵犀峡谷了，马上到达灵犀镇了！”周平山语气中带着愉悦的说道。
郑元雪用手挑开马车车窗的帘子，朝外望去，正前方崎岖的道路蜿蜒穿行于两侧的峡壁之间，仿佛进入了无尽的迷宫，这让郑元雪心中有一丝不详的预感，她们这一行人走的太顺畅了，以她那心思深沉的九皇叔的性格来讲会放过自己吗？她在心里这样问自己世人常说女人的第六感很灵，郑元雪思考了一会儿问道“周大哥，去灵犀镇的路只有这一条吗？”
周平山一愣又打开地图看了看，随后说道“还有一条路，但是要多加三日的行程，我们的食物可能没办法走三日最多只能撑一日半，殿下是害怕伏击吗？”
郑元雪微微点了点头。
周平山思索一下，“要不这样，殿下和杨修两人绕道我们走中间，以现在杨修的实力应该遇到打不过的也可以带着殿下潜入森林逃跑。”
郑元雪摇了摇头说道“算了，这样周大哥你先派一部分侍卫去前面打探我们的马车走在后面，遇到危险还可以撤退。”
周平山点了点头然后没有丝毫犹豫的去吩咐。
行进时跟着周平山的杨修自然听到了这两人的对话，他也朝峡谷望去，这样的地势确实是个伏击的好地方。
不一会儿周平山走回马车旁边向郑元雪说安排好了，然后车队随着侍卫缓缓驶入峡谷，但是车队走了不一会儿便停了下来，周平山来到郑元雪马车前说道“公主，前面遇到了难民！”
郑元雪掀开帘子想问难民有多少人的时候，却发现前面五个人手中提着东西在飞速靠近马车，待走到郑元雪可以看清手里东西的时候，大惊失色他们手里提着的是人头。
周平山见郑元雪脸色发白意识到事情不对，连忙转身，在他转身之际身旁的杨修已经先一步提剑冲了上去。
这五人实力最高的是问道二阶九重，其余的都是问道一阶七八重的，而郑元雪这边最强的周平山才问道二阶七重，至于杨修在遇到白狐之后确实有了好运实力突破了两重来到了问道一阶七重，虽说杨修剑道天赋高可以越级，但是即便是这样面对伏击之人在一打多的情况下也是劣势。
峡谷内伏击之人与周平山杨修相遇停了下来，发现杨修之后开口对身旁的一人说道“怎么比给的队伍人数多了一人？”
身旁之人从破烂的衣服当中拿出书信再次确认了一下，发现确实多了一个杨修待打量杨修的实力后说道“没关系老大我们在五个人派两人拖住多余之人，还有两个去杀了郑元雪即可！”
五人头领点了点头表示可以便丢掉头颅掏出武器准备开始行动。
周平山在探知到这些人的实力的时候便开口大喊道“公主快跑！”而郑元雪听到这一声不顾马车立马弃车往来时路跑。
这时杨修拔剑斩出一股剑气朝五人斩去，周平山也拔剑而出。
五人当中刚刚制定计划那人看到剑气袭来也赶忙用武器格挡，随后知道杨修的实力不一般重新说道“点子有点扎手你们三人拖住这小子我去追杀那公主！”
三人闻言立马围住杨修，而首领和周平山战在一起。
杨修一人面对三人没有丝毫惧怕，体内灵气狂涌，再次挥剑比刚刚更强的剑气横向斩出，将面前三人逼退然后迅速朝着追杀郑元雪那人跑去，虽说杨府基本上都是枪法但是现在杨修施展的身法是他母亲教给他的踏云步，很快便追上了追杀之人这次他没来得及用剑气只是挥剑一斩，追击者感受到危机立马停下慌忙格挡住攻击，他的武器是一把刀，再格挡住剑的瞬间向上一抬然后一刀挥出杀向杨修，杨修赶忙一退，用刀之人见一刀落空立刻双手持刀奋力向前刺去，杨修脚下再一蹬身体再次后移，右手拿剑一挑将攻势化解左手一掌拍出打中敌人将其击退，随后稳住身形将剑入鞘凝聚气势，拔剑术一剑斩出。

持刀之人本能反应将刀横到身前，只是这次结果没有和刚才一样挡住而是刀身被杨修一击斩断，剑势斩断刀身并未停止继续向他身旁斩去，他慌忙用将灵气汇聚于胸口准备抵挡剑势，但是杨修算到了这一点扭转手腕向上一挑剑从斩击胸口变成了脖颈，这次持刀着没有反应过来便被割断了喉咙倒在地上，杨修没看一眼转身向周平山走去。
周平山这边情况非常糟糕，刚刚围杀杨修的人因为杨修的追击转而开始攻击他，本来他一打一就已经非常吃力，现在确是负伤严重，而反观对面二阶九重仿佛在戏耍他一样，他吞咽一口气，施展拔剑术一剑斩出将身前的人逼退口轻语一声“爹娘孩儿不孝了！”翻手取出一枚丹药一口吃下。
周平山吞下丹药瞬间一股气息弥漫他的全身，他的境界从问道二阶五重拔高到了问道三阶二重。
伏杀首领大惊失色道“破天丹！快跑！”
话落四兄弟转身遍跑，但是周平山速度比他们更快，实力的差距让他们很快便被周平山追上，只见周平山随意挥剑便将之前围杀杨修之人斩杀，三人来不及反抗就惊恐的倒下，而首领手持双斧看都没看一眼还在迅速逃跑着。

“哈哈哈哈哈，再给我几年这问道三阶我周平山一定可以达到，受死吧！”周平山追上首领大喝一声挥剑。
首领知道逃不了了，转身准备搏命“强行提升的实力，我不信就拖不住你，将你拖死！”
“你大可以试试！拔剑术！”周平山一剑挥出。
“劈山势！”首领手持双斧高高跃起一股气势随着双斧劈下。
剑和双斧僵持了一下，双斧的气势便败退下来，而身体凌空的首领也被剩余的剑气斩落倒地，但是还有气息，周平山消耗不少身体都开始摇晃起来，但是他的意志拖着他踉跄的向首领走去，看着躺在地上失去反抗能力的首领伸手抓住他的头发一剑将其头颅割了下来。
“哈哈哈哈哈！兄弟们给你们报仇了！”周平山虽然在笑但是他的眼角泛着泪花。
杨修赶到的时候战斗已经结束了，只剩下周平山一手持剑插在地上支撑着身体，一手抓着首领的头颅没了生息。
过了一会儿原本逃的郑元雪也走了过来，周平山鞠了一躬。
“他为什么会死？”杨修淡淡的开口道。
郑元雪愣了一下开口说道“他应该是吃了破天丹！”
“破天丹？”杨修第一次听到这个丹药。
郑元雪见杨修疑惑开口解释“这是皇室特有的丹药，每个侍卫几乎都有，这种丹药的作用是在短时间内极大程度的提升使用者的实力，使其爆发身体潜能战斗，但是时间结束后面临的是全身经脉崩断的死亡，在皇室的记录上使用破天丹的侍卫屈指可数，没想到周大哥为了我竟做到了这一步。”
杨修再次看了周平山一眼转身说道“走吧！”
这次轮到郑元雪疑惑了“去哪里？”

“去镇西关，继续前行！他给了我剑谱就当我个人还他恩情送你到镇西关吧！”杨修叹了口气说道。
郑元雪没说话，但是再次向周平山鞠了一躬然后快步跟上了杨修。

content_en:
"Your Highness, the Lingxi Canyon is ahead, and we will arrive at Lingxi Town soon!" Zhou Pingshan said with joy in his tone.
Zheng Yuanxue opened the curtain of the carriage window with her hand and looked out. The rugged road ahead wound through the canyon walls on both sides, as if she had entered an endless maze. This gave Zheng Yuanxue an ominous premonition in her heart. Their group was walking too smoothly. With her thoughtful character, would the Nine Emperors Uncle let her go? She asked herself in her mind that people often say that women have a very good sixth sense. Zheng Yuanxue thought for a while and asked, "Brother Zhou, is this the only way to Lingxi Town?"
Zhou Pingshan was stunned and opened the map to look at it, then said, "There is another way, but it will take three more days to travel. Our food may not be able to travel for three days and can only last for a day and a half at most. Is Your Highness afraid of an ambush?"
Zheng Yuanxue nodded slightly.
Zhou Pingshan thought about it and said, "Otherwise, His Highness and Yang Xiu will detour around us and walk in the middle. With Yang Xiu's current strength, he should be able to sneak into the forest and escape with His Highness if he encounters someone who cannot be beaten."
Zheng Yuanxue shook her head and said, "Forget it, Brother Zhou, you can send some of the guards to the front to find out if our carriage is walking behind. If there is danger, we can retreat."
Zhou Pingshan nodded and then gave the order without any hesitation.
Yang Xiu, who was following Zhou Pingshan during the march, naturally heard the conversation between the two people. He also looked towards the canyon. Such terrain was indeed a good place for an ambush.
After a while, Zhou Pingshan walked back to the carriage and told Zheng Yuanxue that the arrangements were made. Then the motorcade slowly drove into the canyon with the guards. However, the motorcade stopped after a while. Zhou Pingshan came to Zheng Yuanxue's carriage and said, "Princess, we met refugees ahead!"
When Zheng Yuanxue opened the curtain and wanted to ask how many refugees there were, she found that the five people in front were holding things in their hands and approaching the carriage quickly. When Zheng Yuanxue could see the things in their hands clearly, she was shocked. What they were holding were human heads.
Seeing Zheng Yuanxue's face turning pale, Zhou Pingshan realized something was wrong and quickly turned around. When he turned around, Yang Xiu beside him had already rushed forward with his sword.
The strongest among these five people is the ninth level of Wendao, the second level, and the rest are at the seventh and eighth level of Wendao. Zhou Pingshan, the strongest on Zheng Yuanxue's side, is the second and seventh level of Wenwen. As for Yang Xiu, he did have good luck after meeting the white fox.
The person ambushing in the canyon met Zhou Pingshan Yang Xiu and stopped. After discovering Yang Xiu, he said to the person next to him, "Why is there one more person than the number of people in the team?"
The person next to him took out the letter from the tattered clothes and confirmed it again, and found that there was indeed one more Yang Xiu. After looking at Yang Xiu's strength, he said, "It doesn't matter, boss. Let's send two of the five people to hold down the extra people, and the other two can kill Zheng Yuanxue!"
The five leaders nodded and said it was okay, then threw away their heads and took out their weapons and prepared to take action.
When Zhou Pingshan found out the strength of these people, he shouted, "Princess, run!" When Zheng Yuanxue heard this, she immediately abandoned the carriage and ran away.
At this time, Yang Xiu drew his sword and slashed at the five people with sword energy, and Zhou Pingshan also drew his sword.
Among the five of them, the one who had just made a plan saw the sword energy coming and hurriedly blocked it with his weapon. Then he knew that Yang Xiu's strength was extraordinary and said again, "The idea is a little tricky. You three hold this kid back while I hunt down the princess!"
When the three heard this, they immediately surrounded Yang Xiu, while the leader and Zhou Pingshan fought together.
Yang Xiu faced three people without any fear. The spiritual energy in his body surged wildly. He once again swung his sword with stronger sword energy than before and slashed horizontally. He forced the three people in front of him back and then quickly ran towards the person who was chasing Zheng Yuanxue. Although the Yang family was basically good at marksmanship,Now Yang Xiu was using the Cloud Step that his mother taught him, and he soon caught up with the pursuer. This time, he didn't have time to use his sword energy and just swung his sword to slash. The pursuer felt the crisis and immediately stopped and hurriedly blocked the attack. His weapon was a knife. When he blocked the sword, he raised it up and then swung out the knife. Killing Yang Xiu, Yang Xiu hurriedly retreated. When the sword wielder saw that the sword failed, he immediately held the sword with both hands and stabbed forward with all his strength. Yang Xiu kicked off his feet and moved his body back again. He took the sword with his right hand and lifted it to neutralize the attack. His left hand slapped the enemy with a palm and knocked it back. Then he stabilized his body and put the sword into the sheath to gather momentum. He drew his sword and slashed out with his sword.
The man holding the sword reacted instinctively and thrust the sword in front of him, but this time he did not block it like before but the blade was cut off by Yang Xiu. The sword force cut off the blade and continued to slash towards him. He hurriedly gathered his spiritual energy in his chest to resist the sword force, but Yang Xiu calculated this and twisted his wrist and raised the sword upward from slashing the chest to the neck. This time the sword holder did not react, his throat was cut and he fell to the ground. Yang Xiu turned around and walked towards Zhou Pingshan without looking.
The situation on Zhou Pingshan's side was very bad. The people who had just besieged Yang Xiu turned to attack him because of Yang Xiu's pursuit. He was already struggling to fight one by one, but now he was seriously injured. On the other hand, the second-level ninth level on the opposite side seemed to be playing tricks on him. He swallowed a breath, used the sword drawing technique to slash out with his sword, forced the person in front of him to retreat, and whispered, "My parents are unfilial!" He turned his hand and took out a pill and swallowed it in one gulp.
Zhou Pingshan swallowed the pill and instantly a breath filled his whole body. His realm was raised from the fifth level of the second level of asking questions to the second level of the third level of asking questions.
The leader of the ambush was shocked and said, "Breaking Heaven Pill! Run!"
After saying that, the four brothers turned around and ran, but Zhou Pingshan was faster than them. The difference in strength allowed them to be quickly caught up by Zhou Pingshan. Zhou Pingshan casually swung his sword and killed the people who surrounded Yang Xiu before. The three of them fell down in horror before they could resist. The leader was still running away quickly without even looking at his two axes.

"Hahahahaha, give me a few more years and I, Zhou Pingshan, will definitely be able to reach the third level of this question. Just die!" Zhou Pingshan caught up with the leader and yelled, waving his sword.
The leader knew he couldn't escape, so he turned around and prepared to fight for his life, "If you don't believe that your strength has been forcibly improved, I won't be able to hold you back. I will drag you to death!"
"You can try it! Sword Drawing Technique!" Zhou Pingshan swung his sword.
"Cleaving the mountain!" The leader jumped up high with two axes in his hand and followed them with momentum as he slashed down with the two axes.
The sword and the double axes were in a stalemate for a while, and then the momentum of the double axes retreated. The leader who was in the air was cut down by the remaining sword energy and fell to the ground, but he still had breath. Zhou Pingshan consumed a lot of energy and his body began to shake, but his will dragged him staggering towards the leader. Looking at the leader who was lying on the ground and lost the ability to resist, he reached out, grabbed his hair and cut off his head with a sword.
"Hahahaha! Brothers have avenged you!" Although Zhou Pingshan was smiling, there were tears in the corners of his eyes.
The battle was over when Yang Xiu arrived, and only Zhou Pingshan was left holding a sword on the ground to support his body, and holding the leader's head lifelessly with the other hand.
After a while, Zheng Yuanxue, who had originally escaped, also came over, and Zhou Pingshan bowed.
"Why did he die?" Yang Xiu said lightly.
Zheng Yuanxue was stunned for a moment and said, "He must have taken Potian Pill!"
"Breaking Heaven Pill?" Yang Xiu heard this pill for the first time.
Seeing Yang Xiu's doubts, Zheng Yuanxue explained, "This is a unique elixir for the royal family. Almost every guard has it. The function of this elixir is to greatly enhance the user's strength in a short period of time, allowing the user to burst into battle with his physical potential. However, after the time is over, he will face death due to the collapse of the meridians throughout his body. There are only a handful of guards who have used the Sky-Breaking Dan in the royal family's records. Unexpectedly, Brother ZhouFor me to do this. "
Yang Xiu glanced at Zhou Pingshan again and turned around and said, "Let's go! "
This time it was Zheng Yuanxue’s turn to wonder, “Where to go? "
“Go to Zhenxiguan and keep moving forward! If he gave me the sword manual, just treat it as my personal repayment of his kindness and send you to Zhenxiguan! Yang Xiu said with a sigh.
Zheng Yuanxue said nothing, but bowed to Zhou Pingshan again and quickly followed Yang Xiu.
